blocks.text: Needs review by a South African attorney or the appointed Information Officer before use. This is a drafting outline, not legal advice and not an approved document. The statutes and instruments named are pointers for the reviewer: POPIA (Act 4 of 2013) chapter 3.

checks.label: Accountability: Information Officer appointed and registered
Processing limitation: lawful ground recorded for each purpose
Purpose specification: purposes written down, retention set by the school
Further processing limitation: new uses checked against the declared purpose
Openness: privacy notice and PAIA manual published
Security safeguards: policy, access control, breach SOP tested
Data subject participation: request route and SOP in use
Operator agreements signed with every school
